description: The clock and round-trip estimator pinned across the SDKs (#1398): `options` builds the clock, then `events` are applied in order — `frame` (onFrame), `period` (onPeriodChange), `reset`, `update` (update(nowMs), then the clock's state must equal `expect`), `phase` (subTickPhase(atMs, oneWayDelayMs) must equal `value`) and `pong` (the PingScheduler's onPong with clientMs and recvMs, after which rttMs and lastRttMs must equal `expect`). Every double is its IEEE bits as 16 hex digits; ticks are plain integers. Generated from the .NET Clock and RoundTripEstimator.
